items.title: Awesome Research
items.content_text:
### Plotting and Charting Online / Enterprise Git Service

*   [Scientific Figure](https://scientificfigure.com/): AI tool that draws scientific illustrations, graphical abstracts, data plots, and conference posters from a text prompt, sketch, or PDF; exports SVG and PPTX at journal column widths.

### Datasets / Social Sciences

*   [twtData X Trends Archive](https://twtdata.com/twitter-trends/) (`Lookup`): X (Twitter) trending topics by country and city, with a page for each past day; the largest countries are recorded hourly.

### Writing / Social Sciences

*   [Articlo](https://getarticlo.com/): Prepares existing Word manuscripts for a target journal with an editable document, change summary, and author checklist. Free readiness check; paid manuscript preparation.

### Notebooks for Researchers / Social Sciences

*   [Glasp](https://glasp.co): Web and YouTube highlighter with AI summaries and notes, plus Kindle highlights import. Browser extensions, iOS and Android apps, and an MCP server; export to Notion, Obsidian and Zotero.

### Editors / Markdown

*   [markon](https://metaory.github.io/markon/) (`Cloud`, `Local PWA`): Minimal distraction-free live Markdown editor.

### Editors / LaTeX

*   [Manulyx](https://manulyx.com/)(`Cloud`): Online LaTeX editor for writing and revising papers with co-authors: real-time co-editing, track changes, publisher templates, submission stages, response-to-reviewers letters and marked manuscripts. Free plan available.
*   [Oleafly](https://oleafly.com) - Open-source desktop editor for LaTeX, Typst and Markdown with a built-in LaTeX engine, live PDF preview and Zotero citations. Runs offline on macOS, Windows and Linux.

### Code Editors / HTML+CSS+JS

*   [neovim](https://neovim.io/)(`Free`,`Cross-platform`,`Plugins`): Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability.

### Investigate Papers / HTML+CSS+JS

*   [JournalCompass](https://journalcompass.com): Free bilingual journal finder: CAS zones, impact factors, review times, APC/OA status and an AI journal matcher.

### Bibliography / HTML+CSS+JS

*   [citeguard (⭐1)](https://github.com/wedo911/citeguard): Checks a `.bib`/`.ris` bibliography (or a single DOI) for cited papers that have been retracted, corrected, or flagged with an expression of concern, via Crossref and the Retraction Watch records it carries. Python library/CLI, MCP server, and GitHub Action; no API key. `pip install citeguard-cli`
*   [Reference Verifier (⭐0)](https://github.com/the-aurora-lab/reference-verifier): Checks that every reference in a .bib file or LaTeX paper exists in Crossref, OpenAlex, DBLP, arXiv or PubMed, and flags invented papers and wrong DOIs. Open source (MIT).

### Tips for Researchers / HTML+CSS+JS

*   [ProfScout](https://profscout.com): Finds professors most likely to reply to research cold emails, ranked by reply-fit. Freemium.

### More / HTML+CSS+JS

*   [ToolStack](https://tools.mindutil.com/en): a free toolbox of 122 browser-based utilities (text, JSON, image, PDF, unit conversion, color) that run entirely client-side, with no signup and no file uploads.

items.title: Free for Dev
items.content_text:
### Messaging and Streaming

*   [GravEx Chat](https://chat.gravex.app/en/) - Free chat sdk that works for any client, like web, Android, iOS or whatever. Create API key and hand it over to your own Agent(Claude, Codex...) with [llms.txt](https://chat.gravex.app/en/llms.txt), then you get your messenger to your service. It's that simple.

### Web Hosting

*   [Reliant](https://reliantlabs.io) - Host, monitor, and deploy your services with production best practices. Tracing, continuous profiling, metrics, and logs fully baked in and correlated with each release allow you to identify and auto rollback on demand. One free static site per organization, 1 GiB of storage, 10 GiB of traffic a month, CDN with HTTPS, custom domains, no card needed, deployed with the open-source forge CLI.

### Analytics, Events and Statistics

*   [RudderStack](https://rudderstack.com/) - Event streaming to 200+ destinations and data warehouse, plus reverse ETL. Comes with MCP server and CLI for AI agents. Free forever for 250k events/month.

items.title: Collective Ai Tools
items.content_text:
### 3D

*   [objekto.io](https://objekto.io/en) - Turns a few words, a photo or a sketch into a multi-part, print-ready 3D model designed by AI, then has it 3D printed and delivered (France only for now). `#freemium`

### Design

*   [DESIGN:OS Studio](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-studio/) - FREE desktop design studio where your own AI agent designs on .fig files and you refine on a GPU canvas. `#free` `#design`

### Developer Tools

*   [Continua](https://continua-nu.vercel.app/) - Experimental macOS 13+ companion designed to resume interrupted Codex Desktop coding tasks after supported usage resets, with local task history; unsigned/not notarized, manual updates, and genuine unattended recovery unverified. `#free`
*   [HopBase](https://hop-base.com/) - AI API gateway with one base URL for Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and Qwen text models plus image and video models such as Seedream, Seedance and Kling, compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini endpoints. `#paid` `#api` `#llm`
*   [MailVeri MCP (⭐1)](https://github.com/mailveri/mailveri-mcp) - Open-source MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor and other agents verify single emails and bulk lists via the MailVeri API (SMTP, catch-all, disposable and role detection). `#freemium` `#opensource` `#mcp`

### Human Resources

*   [CookLLM](https://cookllm.com/en/jobs/match) - AI job matcher that emails you new AI jobs from 1,300+ AI companies' career pages and hiring posts on X and LinkedIn, scored against your resume. `#paid`

### Image Generator

*   [AI Anime Generator](https://ai-anime-generator.io/) - Create anime portraits and original characters from text or reference images, with 40 one-time signup credits. `#freemium`
*   [ThumbnailSnap](https://thumbnailsnap.com/youtube-thumbnail-maker) - Generates YouTube, Shorts and TikTok thumbnails with AI and keeps the title as an editable text layer; cropping your own photo and adding text is free. `#freemium`

### Marketing

*   [Revenue Scout](https://revenuescout.ai/) - Finds public posts where people need what you sell and drafts replies for you to review and post. `#freemium` `#lead-generation`

### Meeting

*   [Meetini](https://meetini.net/) - Meeting and interview assistant for Apple Silicon Macs with local captions, transcripts, meeting notes, and metered AI assistance. `#paid`

### Prompts

*   [AgentCraft Nano Banana 2.1 Prompts](https://agentcraft.dev/en/prompts/image/nano-banana-2-1/) - 90 Nano Banana 2.1 image prompts, each shown with its output, in a free library of 2,473 image and video prompts that also covers Seedance 2.5 and Kling 4.0. `#free`
*   [Prompt Generator](https://trypromptgenerator.com) - Writes prompts in the syntax of the AI tool you pick (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, Nano Banana, Veo, Sora and more), with 10 free prompts a day and no sign-up. `#freemium` `#writing`

### Real Estate

*   [EmptyRoom AI](https://emptyroomai.com/) - Furnish vacant listing photos in any style for agents and sellers, with unlimited free restages. `#paid`
*   [MotionCasa](https://motioncasa.com/) - Creates listing videos from property photos with AI motion and reel templates; AI generation requires purchased credits. `#paid`

### SEO

*   [Akii: SEO & AI Search Optimizer](https://akii.com/portfolio#search-optimizer) - Audits sites, checks links, plans content, and adds JSON-LD with a free Claude Code plugin. `#free` `#opensource` `#seo`

### Video

*   [AI Rap Video](https://airapvideo.us/) - AI rap video generator: write or draft rap lyrics, pick a photo, original character or duo, and get a short lip-synced rap clip (8-15s); packs from $4.99. `#paid`
*   [EasyRap](https://easyrapvideo.com/) - Creates short rap music videos from one or two photos using paid credits. `#paid`
*   [Valmera](https://valmera.io/) - Edits uploaded footage through natural-language instructions in a browser studio or a connected AI assistant over MCP, with cuts, captions, reframing, preview review and MP4 export. `#paid` `#video` `#mcp`

items.title: Awesome Integration
items.content_text:
### Projects / AI Gateway

*   [agentgateway (⭐6.1k) (⭐6k)](https://github.com/agentgateway/agentgateway) - An open-source data plane for agentic AI connectivity, providing security, observability, and governance for agent-to-tool (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication.
*   [Bifrost (⭐9.4k) (⭐9.2k)](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost) - A high-performance AI gateway written in Go that unifies more than 20 model providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible API, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, and governance.
*   [LiteLLM (⭐63k) (⭐62k)](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm) - An LLM gateway that exposes 100+ model providers through a unified OpenAI-compatible API, with spend tracking, fallbacks, and rate limiting.
*   [MCPJungle (⭐1.6k) (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/mcpjungle/MCPJungle) - A self-hosted MCP gateway and registry that centralises multiple MCP servers behind one endpoint for AI agents.

### Projects / API Design

*   [OpenAPI Diff (⭐1.1k) (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/OpenAPITools/openapi-diff) - Compare OpenAPI specs with version control and visualize the differences in HTML or Markdown format.
*   [Zally (⭐948) (⭐947)](https://github.com/zalando/zally) - Ensure the quality of your OpenAPI specs with this linter tool that provides extensive analysis and feedback.

### Projects / API Documentation

*   [DapperDox (⭐417) (⭐416)](https://github.com/DapperDox/dapperdox) - Generates elegant, interactive API documentation from OpenAPI/Swagger specs with easy customization and automated updates.
*   [Redoc (⭐26k) (⭐26k)](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc) - Delivers clean, modern documentation with advanced theming, multi-language support, and seamless integration.
*   [Slate (⭐35k) (⭐36k)](https://github.com/slatedocs/slate) - Converts markdown into stylish, static API documentation with intuitive navigation and clear code examples.
*   [Zudoku (⭐621) (⭐620)](https://github.com/zuplo/zudoku) - A customizable framework built on OpenAPI, focused on delivering exceptional developer experiences through quality documentation.

### Projects / API Gateway

*   [Higress (⭐9.7k) (⭐9.7k)](https://github.com/higress-group/higress) - A next-generation cloud-native gateway based on Envoy and Istio, offering high performance, easy-to-use, and rich plugin extensibility.

### Projects / API Management

*   [Gravitee.io API Management (⭐470) (⭐469)](https://github.com/gravitee-io/gravitee-api-management) - A lightweight, open-source platform offering flexible API governance, robust security, and straightforward configuration.

### Projects / API Testing

*   API clients
    *   [Bruno (⭐48k) (⭐48k)](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno) - A fast, offline API client designed for git-friendly workflows and seamless testing.
    *   [curl (⭐43k) (⭐43k)](https://github.com/curl/curl) - A versatile command-line tool for data transfer across multiple protocols, essential for quick API testing.
    *   [curlie (⭐3.7k) (⭐3.7k)](https://github.com/rs/curlie) - A modern, user-friendly frontend to curl that combines simplicity with powerful performance.
    *   [gRPC UI (⭐5.9k) (⭐5.9k)](https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcui) - An interactive web-based tool for gRPC APIs, providing a browser-based interface for testing and exploring gRPC services with dynamic form generation.
    *   [grpcurl (⭐12k) (⭐13k)](https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl) - A command-line tool for interacting with gRPC servers, enabling inspection and invocation of RPC methods with support for server reflection and protocol buffer files.
    *   [Hoppscotch (⭐80k) (⭐81k)](https://github.com/hoppscotch/hoppscotch) - A lightweight, web-based API development tool offering real-time testing with an intuitive interface.
    *   [HTTPie (⭐38k) (⭐39k)](https://github.com/httpie/httpie) - An intuitive CLI HTTP client that simplifies crafting API requests and inspecting responses.
    *   [HttpMaster](https://www.httpmaster.net/) - Free and lightweight desktop tool for HTTP testing and debugging.
    *   [Insomnia (⭐40k) (⭐40k)](https://github.com/Kong/insomnia) - A cross-platform client that streamlines API debugging and testing for both REST and GraphQL services.
    *   [posting (⭐12k) (⭐13k)](https://github.com/darrenburns/posting) - A modern, terminal-based API client designed for efficient and seamless API interactions.
    *   [Postman](https://www.postman.com/product/api-client/) - The industry-standard tool for API development and testing, featuring automation, mock servers, and collaborative documentation.
    *   [Requestly (⭐6.7k) (⭐6.8k)](https://github.com/requestly/requestly) - Lightweight Git-Friendly API Client Built for Modern Developers.
    *   [resty (⭐2.6k) (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/micha/resty) - A tiny command-line REST client implemented as shell functions around curl, handy for quick API exploration from the terminal.
    *   [SoapUI (⭐1.7k) (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/SmartBear/soapui) - A comprehensive open-source solution for testing both SOAP and REST web services with extensive automation features.
    *   [Wombat (⭐1.4k) (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/rogchap/wombat) - A cross-platform desktop gRPC client with automatic proto parsing, TLS support, and intuitive UI for testing unary, streaming, and bidirectional gRPC requests.
    *   [xh (⭐8.1k) (⭐8.2k)](https://github.com/ducaale/xh) - A fast, friendly CLI HTTP client that reimplements HTTPie's design with improved performance, HTTP/2 support, and built-in curl translation.
    *   [Yaade (⭐1.9k) (⭐2k)](https://github.com/EsperoTech/yaade) - A self-hosted, collaborative API development environment designed for team sharing with multi-user support, persistent storage, and support for REST, WebSockets, and Markdown documentation.
    *   [Yaak (⭐19k) (⭐19k)](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak) - A fast, privacy-first desktop API client for REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, Server-Sent Events, and gRPC with offline-first design, built with Tauri and React.
*   Testing tools and frameworks
    *   [Apache JMeter (⭐9.6k) (⭐9.6k)](https://github.com/apache/jmeter) - A feature-rich tool for load testing and performance analysis across diverse web applications and services.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [ClipUGC (⭐4)](https://github.com/clipugc/ClipUGC-CLI) - Gemini CLI extension that makes UGC style vertical videos for your app with AI influencers who keep the same face: describe an AI influencer, add a screen recording of your app, and get a ready-to-post video with a hook line for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Bundles the hosted ClipUGC MCP server (OAuth sign-in, no API key), four Agent Skills and a `GEMINI.md` context file; needs a ClipUGC account, with free credits to try. Local stdio alternative: `npx -y clipugc mcp` with `CLIPUGC_API_KEY` (paid plans). MIT. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/clipugc/ClipUGC-CLI`.

items.title: Awesome Webgl
items.content_text:
### Tools/Debugging

*   [WebGL GLSL Editor](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=raczzalan.webgl-glsl-editor) - GLSL language support extension for Visual Studio Code.
*   [KTX2 Texture Compressor](https://app.cinevva.com/tools/ktx2-compressor) - Browser tool to convert PNG, JPG, and WebP textures to KTX2 (Basis Universal, UASTC or ETC1S) to cut VRAM and load time. Runs locally, no upload.

### Others / Particles

*   [Novaframe Engine (⭐0)](https://github.com/novaframe-hq/novaframe-engine) - Open-source desktop live wallpaper runtime for interactive WebGL and Three.js shaders.
